C# Dev Kit — Diagnostic Log Archive
An archive was generated by the **C# Dev Kit extension for Visual Studio Code** (`C# Dev Kit: Collect Logs` command).
These files reflect the state of your VS Code session at the time logs were collected.
VS Code version, OS, .NET SDK info, and installed extensions.
Relevant VS Code extension settings. Sensitive values (tokens, passwords, connection strings) are redacted.
C# Dev Kit log entries for Project System, NuGet, Test Explorer, and the overall extension.
Detailed logs for helper processes launched as part of the C# Dev Kit session.
.NET Install Tool acquisition logs, including PATH/environment checks and startup race details.
C# extension output logs (language server, LSP trace, Razor).
Activity logs capture live output recorded during the diagnostic session with the log level set to Trace.
These cover **only** the recording window — from when you started the recording until you stopped it.
C# output captured during the recording session.
LSP trace between VS Code and the Roslyn language server captured during the recording session.
Razor output captured during the recording session.
One or more `.nettrace` files captured using `dotnet-trace` during the recording session.
These contain runtime events from the C# Dev Kit server processes.

You can view these files using [PerfView](https://github.com/microsoft/perfview), [dotnet-trace convert](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/core/diagnostics/dotnet-trace#dotnet-trace-convert), or Visual Studio.
One or more `.dmp` files captured using `dotnet-dump`. These contain a full process memory dump of the C# Dev Kit server processes.
Because a recording session was also active, dumps were collected in **before/after** pairs (`before-*.dmp` and `after-*.dmp`) so you can compare memory state before and after reproducing the issue.
Memory dumps contain the full process memory and may include sensitive data such as source code, file contents, and credentials loaded in memory.
One or more `.gcdump` files captured using `dotnet-gcdump`. These contain managed heap information from the C# Dev Kit server processes.
Because a recording session was also active, GC dumps were collected in **before/after** pairs (`before-*.gcdump` and `after-*.gcdump`) for comparison.
This archive may contain sensitive information such as file paths, project names, source code fragments, and other workspace-specific details. Please review the contents before sharing publicly.

**Privately**: If the archive contains sensitive information, upload it via the [Developer Community](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/dotnet/report) page and reference your GitHub issue in the description.
For more information see the [Microsoft Privacy Statement](https://privacy.microsoft.com/privacystatement).
